generation_prompt: Produce one exact SQUARE 1:1 transparent PNG sprite sheet with a precise TWO by TWO grid (2 columns, 2 rows), FOUR scene frames. No grid lines, labels, numbers, text or background. This is a very simple monochrome low-resolution retro pixel game, not an illustration: coarse visible square pixels, hard stair-step outlines, flat clusters of black, dark gray, light gray and white only. No anti-aliasing, soft shading, glow, vignette, external shadows, 3D toy styling, cute faces or smiles. Each scene is one CONNECTED little fishing scene: a small human angler wearing a plain cap and coat, seated at the LEFT end of a tiny flat dock/ledge, holding a fishing rod towards the RIGHT. Neutral side silhouette with no detailed face or oversized head. A minimal rod, thin line, small bobber and the tiny ledge are the only props. NO rocks, grass, plants, aquarium, treasure, landscape, full water surface or decorative UI. The dock is only a few square pixels thick beneath the person. Every scene fits entirely within the centered 70% of its equal square cell, with at least 15% completely transparent margin on every side. Preserve EXACTLY the same character position, body scale, dock position and rod anchor across all four frames for animation. Frame0 top-left: idle, angler seated, rod angled somewhat up, line and bobber close. Frame1 top-right: waiting, angler seated in same spot, rod held out to right, thin line down to small bobber, at most three tiny square ripples. Frame2 bottom-left: bite, SAME seated angler and dock anchor, rod tip slightly bent and bobber with two tiny pixel bite accents. Frame3 bottom-right: catch, SAME angler and dock anchor, arm/rod raised and ONE small fish on the line. Keep the minimal entire scene connected and coherent, no disconnected inventory objects. Clear readable silhouette at 180-220px screen display. Exact square final canvas with two equal rows and columns, no automatic trimming of outer transparent margins.
edit_prompt: Correct only the SPRITE SHEET ALIGNMENT of this transparent monochrome pixel-art fishing sheet. Keep the same simple angler, cap, coat, bench, rod and four poses; no new objects. Final canvas EXACTLY SQUARE with TWO equal columns and TWO equal rows. Every square cell uses the SAME local coordinate anchors: cap top at x=28% y=32%, seated body center x=30% y=52%, flat bench top spans x=18% to x=42% at y=65%, bench legs stop at y=77%. The same bench and seated torso must land at precisely these same fractional positions in ALL FOUR cells, rather than centering the whole scene's different bounding box. Rod handle at x=42% y=50%, rightmost fishing line/fish at x=78%. All sprites remain inside x=15..85% and y=15..85%, with FULLY TRANSPARENT outer gutters. Top-left idle, top-right waiting, bottom-left bite, bottom-right catch. In the waiting/bite frames the rod differs only slightly in bend and tiny bite accents; in catch the raised arm and ONE fish are the only important pose changes. Preserve coarse hard pixel blocks and neutral grayscale, no smiles or cute eyes, no antialiasing, glow, backdrop, checkerboard or text. Do not trim the square image. The purpose is stable no-jump animation by swapping equal square frames.
